description: This file contains functions for normalizing and validating provider plugin configurations, including diagnostics, authentication methods, wizard setup, and registration logic.

methods.name: pushProviderDiagnostic
methods.description: Pushes a diagnostic message using the provided callback.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims a string or returns undefined if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: normalizeTextList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of strings by trimming, filtering, and removing duplicates.

methods.name: normalizeOnboardingScopes
methods.description: Filters and deduplicates onboarding scope values.

methods.name: normalizeProviderOAuthProfileIdRepairs
methods.description: Normalizes OAuth profile ID repair objects.

methods.name: normalizeProviderWizardSetup
methods.description: Validates and normalizes provider wizard setup data.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthMethods
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication methods, ensuring unique IDs.

methods.name: normalizeProviderWizard
methods.description: Normalizes the provider wizard configuration, including setup and model picker.

methods.name: normalizeRegisteredProvider
methods.description: Validates and normalizes a provider registration object, handling conflicts and missing data.
